## ZGTA V — AppSync installer
**Build89 experimental candidate · by zema.**

Only for compatible ARM64 rootful jailbreaks on iOS 15.0–18.2 without TrollStore. Not for RootHide or rootless. Prefer the separate TrollStore installer when supported.

Uses official **AppSync Unified (116.0+)** and **appinst (2.1.1+)** from https://cydia.akemi.ai/ — add that source in Sileo so it can resolve dependencies. Its server timed out during our 2026-10-26 checks; dependency availability is unverified. No dependencies are downloaded or installed secretly by this package.

Downloads the pinned IPA, checks size and SHA-256, and runs appinst. Own game files required. Removing this wrapper leaves the app and its data installed. No uninstall or force-overwrite fallback.

### Verification
Local installer tests and archive checks pass. Actual AppSync installation, app launch, gameplay, updates and reboot behavior are **untested**. An active compatible jailbreak is required; this is not TrollStore-style persistence. It will not silently migrate a TrollStore-managed copy. Read the Sileo log if installation fails.
